title: Validate beginner and expert task completion
objective: Real intended users can use the product and interpret its limitations correctly.
outcome: A reproducible moderated protocol names eight novice and eight advanced actual participants distinct from implementers, frozen opaque tasks, success criteria, help rules and non-PHI notes. Human participants are separate from agent simulations. If participants are unavailable, R12 remains unverified and implementer self-tests cannot satisfy it. Missing or untested assigned opportunities count as non-completions. Tiny-group results are not a population-wide usability claim. Testing materials never require protected research data. R12 and R13 remain unaccepted. C-009-1 remains unresolved. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task.

commits.subject: Prepare a reproducible moderated protocol
commits.instructions: Specify eight novice/eight advanced participants, frozen tasks, success criteria, help rules and non-PHI notes. Separate human participants from agent simulations.
commits.verification: Tasks test finding, interpreting, accessing and citing sources; merely clicking through a page is not completion.

commits.subject: Collect consented task evidence
commits.instructions: Run the protocol or ingest documented sessions from the product owner/research facilitator. Record completion, critical misunderstandings, observed friction and untested cases.
commits.verification: If participants are unavailable, retain unverified status; implementer self-tests cannot satisfy R12.

commits.subject: Report and route concrete failures
commits.instructions: Compute completion by group and task, with counts and limitations; create targeted fixes for access/grain/price misunderstandings and poor navigation.
commits.verification: Require >=85% completion in each group and no critical misunderstanding; tiny-group results are product acceptance evidence, not a population-wide usability claim.
